question: The Bishnu Rabha Award 2019 went to the noted ________ dance exponent Kumari Laitjonam Ebampisok Devi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumari Laitjonam Ebampisok Devi **is a noted **Manipuri dance exponent**.
 
• She received the **Bishnu Rabha Award in 2019**.
 
• The award recognizes outstanding contributions to **art and culture in Assam**.
 
• **Devi's expertise in Manipuri dance** has contributed significantly to the **preservation and promotion of the art form**.
 
• The award highlights her dedication to enriching the **cultural heritage of Manipur through dance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bishnu Rabha Award** 

 
 
• Named after** Bishnu Prasad Rabha**, a prominent **Assamese cultural icon**.
 
• The **Bishnu Rabha Award** was **established** in the year **2003**.
 
• **Established to honour** individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the field of **art and culture in Assam.**
 
• Award recognizes achievements in various forms of art, including **music, dance, theatre, literature, and visual arts**.
 
• Given **annually to deserving artists and cultural practitioners**.
 
• Aim to **promote and preserve** the rich cultural **heritage of Assam**.
